_comment: The realistic first answer: the standard Express advice, applied without checking what it trusts. Must score < 0.3.
culprit: The reverse proxy address is being recorded instead of the visitor, so the ip columns fill with ::1.
evidence: Every page line says ::1, on two different surfaces six months apart.
why_it_was_missed: The proxy sends the real address in a header the app ignores, so req.ip stays as the socket peer.

fix.ordering: at the top of the file

does_not_fix: Nothing else. This is the standard Express setting when you are behind a proxy.
